title: Blood Donation drive
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim organised Blood Donation Drive in October 2026, at ITI Dadar on 17th October, with the support of Tata Memorial Hospital staff in managing the camps.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim organised Blood Donation Drive in October 2026, at ITI Dadar on 17th October, with the support of Tata Memorial Hospital
staff in managing the camps.
The drive received a response, with 25 donors. Rtns. Ninad, Vandana and Dr Anjali, along with Mr Salvi, generously donated blood, exemplifying the
spirit of service and compassion.
